svg.title: Contours of two-dimensional Gaussian densities
svg.desc: Six panels of contour lines, all drawn at the same four density heights. With covariance the identity the contours are circles; at 0.6 times the identity they are smaller and the highest level appears, because the peak is taller; at twice the identity they are larger and only the lowest level exists. With positive off-diagonal entries the circles become ellipses tilted along the line z2 equals z1, narrower as the entry grows to 0.8; with a negative entry they tilt the other way. A dashed line marks the leading eigenvector, which is the long axis of each ellipse.
